notes: 02: title-fetcher only extracts ; no description, favicon, or preview image collected. 07: card shows title/tags/notes/domain but no favicon (uses a letter mark) and no description field exists. 10: tags entered as a plain comma-separated input, no autocomplete of existing tags. 14: search is a single LIKE substring; no #tag syntax parsing. 15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised group parsing. 16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling; quotes are treated literally. 17/18/19: no read/unread reading-queue concept; only an isomorphic 'Favorites' boolean flag with a favorites filter and toggle, different semantics from read-later/mark-as-read. 20: no multi-select or bulk-action capability. 21: no filter-scoped bulk action. 22: list is always ordered created_at DESC; no sort-key control. 23: notes are stored/editable and shown, but rendered as plain text in a <p>, not rendered as markdown. 24/25: no snapshot or Internet Archive functionality. 29: no bundle/saved-filter feature. 30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. 32: no user display settings (sort/items/font size).
